posts.title: home again, sort of
posts.description: I was admitted to the hospital for a week, in an effort to keep me alive when released I panicked as I had been taking meds every hour, IV antibiotics continuously the whole time, tests, expectations, uncontrolled blood sugar and pressure, pain... I got these when one lucky woman was released after one day... she passed these on to several of us They did perk up my mood reminding me of Van Gogh...

posts.title: creativity? and real life
posts.description: Feels like I am being swarmed by 100 wasps... so many demands, so many pains, so much I have no idea how to do.... so one night I watched TV and basted hexies. here they are laid out, neutrals... Ready to sew to each other and I painted a bird one morning... from imagination obviously. his wing looks like a kerhief I feel like I am disappearing under a tsunami wave, fading away to beige do any of

posts.title: grow through the chaos
posts.description: first painting done in a long time.... creativity takes a back seat to terror and pain....
